items.title: A universally injective etale morphism is an open immersion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is a single sentence -- a universally injective etale morphism of schemes is an open immersion -- and its first proof is a sequence of carefully chosen reductions (statement lines 6620-6623, proof lines 6625-6641). The morphism is first replaced by its image, which is open because etale morphisms are open, so that one may assume it surjective; it is then bijective and open, hence a homeomorphism, and in particular quasi-compact. At that point the author invokes the criterion that a flat, surjective, quasi-compact monomorphism is an isomorphism, so the task becomes showing that the morphism is a monomorphism, which is done by observing that for an etale morphism the diagonal is an open immersion, that universal injectivity makes the diagonal surjective, and that an open immersion which is surjective is an isomorphism. The claim is H2: there is one line of argument rather than several independent ones, but it consists of a reduction to the surjective case, an application of a criterion, and an identification of the diagonal, each of which has to be seen.
